message.content: The founder of Buddhism was **Siddhartha Gautama**, who is revered as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”). He was born in the ancient kingdom of **Magadha** (in the area that is now the Indian state of Bihar, near the modern border with Nepal). Buddhism originated in the **Indian subcontinent**, with its earliest teachings emerging in what is today **India and Nepal**.
